01 — THE OPPORTUNITY

The biggest shelf in NCR, still under-told.

India's young drinkers don't discover liquor in stores anymore. They discover it on a screen first — then walk in to buy it. G-Town already has their attention in store. Now it needs it on the feed.

Every bottle on a G-Town shelf — thousands of labels across 50 stores — is a piece of content waiting to happen: an origin story, a serve, a pairing, a personality. Today most of that potential shows up as a price tag. Great for the deal-hunter; wasted on the drinker who would fall in love with the brand.

"People don't follow a liquor store. They follow a taste, a vibe, and a reason to come back."

Brands like Ice Please and unsobered have proven the playbook: smart, shareable content turns followers into a community that shows up. G-Town has built a six-figure audience once before — and knows exactly what that reach is worth. This time we build it faster and on stronger foundations: an account engineered to last, tuned to G-Town's catalogue, cities and its "Be Original, Buy Original" promise.

03 — THE CONTENT PLAYBOOK

Formats that already go viral — rebuilt for your shelf.

Here are proven content formats from across the category — two of them yours — and exactly how we'd build and scale each one for G-Town Wines to maximise shares, saves and follows.

REF · @unsobered
Personality / Tag-a-friend Carousel

"What your drink order says about you"

Inspired by @unsobered's relatable cocktail-personality format.

Personality content is the single most shareable format in the category — people tag friends, repost to stories and debate in comments. It turns a passive viewer into a distributor.

Our spin: "What your bottle says about you" — each slide pairs a personality with a product actually on the G-Town shelf. Old Monk = the loyal nostalgic. Indri single malt = the slow sipper. 818 Tequila = the life of the party. Soft product placement that sells while it entertains.
HIGH SHAREABILITYSAVES + TAGSSOFT SELL
REF · @unsobered
Discovery / Educational Listicle

"8 bottles from around the world on our shelf"

Inspired by @unsobered's "8 Rums You Need To Try" carousel.

Listicles get saved — and saves are the strongest signal Instagram rewards with reach. They also position G-Town as a curator, not just the cheapest counter in town.

Our spin: "8 rare finds you didn't know were in Gurugram." Each slide spotlights a world whisky, gin or rum stocked at G-Town, with the nearest outlet on the slide — turning your inventory into a treasure hunt people screenshot and come in to find.
SAVE-DRIVINGAUTHORITYDISCOVERY
REF · @unsobered
New Arrival / Launch Hype

"New on the shelf" — launch alerts

Inspired by @unsobered's "New Launch Alert: Absolut × Tomorrowland."

FOMO is fuel. A "just landed" post gives followers a reason to visit now and makes G-Town the first place NCR hears about limited editions and new drops.

Our spin: Every new bottle or limited edition that lands at G-Town — an Indri Founder's Reserve, a Tigerfire, the next big collab bottle — gets a cinematic "New Arrival" reel + story. We turn ordinary restocking into news — and news brings people in before stock runs out.
FOMOFOOTFALLFIRST-TO-KNOW
YOURS · G-TOWN WINES
How-To / Serve Guide

"How to serve it right" — your format, systemised

Your own "How To Refresh — Soju in 3 Steps." A post we've been pointing other brands to — and worth relaunching on the new handle.

Utility content earns trust. Simple, beautifully illustrated "how to serve / pour / pair" guides keep people coming back and make a single product feel worth buying. You've already proved the format works — right now it's a one-off. It should be a franchise.

Our spin: A weekly illustrated series in one consistent look — soju serves, the perfect G&T ratio, whisky neat-vs-rocks, sangria in 4 steps — every edition carrying the G-Town seal, store list and WhatsApp number exactly like this one. Educational, branded, and quietly directing people to the nearest outlet.
UTILITYREPEAT VALUESTORE-BRANDED
YOURS · G-TOWN WINES
Recurring Monthly Series

"Shelf Spotlight" — from a post to a ritual

Your own "June Shelf Spotlight: Tequila." The right idea, waiting to become a habit.

A recurring series builds a habit — followers start expecting it. It organises your enormous catalogue into bite-sized, seasonal themes and gives the calendar a reliable anchor.

Our spin: Lock it in as a monthly mini-campaign, not just a carousel — Tequila & rosé in summer, mulled wine & whisky in winter, bubbly for New Year. Each edition: carousel + reel + story poll + an in-store L-1 offer, pushed to the outlets nearest each follower.
SERIESSEASONALCATALOGUE

05 — OFFER AMPLIFICATION

Your offers deserve an audience.

G-Town already runs the most aggressive offers in NCR — gift-with-purchase, ₹950 monsoon deals, brand-backed bundles. Right now they reach whoever happens to scroll past. Here's how every offer reaches tens of thousands of the right people the day it drops.

YOUR LIVE OFFERS · @gtown.l1

A new offer almost every week, a brand partner behind many of them, and a price story no one in NCR can match. That's a content engine most brands would pay for. What it's missing is distribution — and a way to know which offer brought which customer into which store.

01Offer hits the shelfMonsoon Sale, Laphroaig backpack, 12-bottle trolley deal — whatever's live this week
02We package it in 24 hoursOne kit: reel + 3 stories + WhatsApp card + Meta ad set + creator brief, all in one look
03Pushed across four channels at onceCreators, WhatsApp, the Instagram community and geo-fenced Meta ads — same day
04Redemptions tracked per storeOffer codes, click-to-call and WhatsApp replies tell us what worked — and where
Channel 01 · Creators

Influencer drops

Gurugram food, nightlife and lifestyle creators unbox the offer — "two Laphroaigs, one backpack" — as a reel and story the day it goes live. Their followers are already your customers; we just point them to the nearest G-Town.

  • Micro & nano creators (10K–100K) on barter + fee
  • Story swipe-ups straight to WhatsApp
  • A unique code per creator, so we know who drives footfall
  • Brand partners (Laphroaig, Cambridge, Snob) co-fund the bigger names
KPI · Reach · Cost per redemption
Channel 02 · Direct

Bulk WhatsApp

Everyone who has ever called 8510033333 for a price is a warm lead. We build an opted-in WhatsApp Business list, store by store, and broadcast each offer as a rich card with one-tap Call · Directions · Order.

  • Opt-in QR at every counter + on every ad
  • Segmented by store and by what they buy — whisky vs gin vs wine
  • Offer card with the nearest store's CTA, not a generic blast
  • Opt-in only and policy-compliant — no spam, no account risk
KPI · Open rate · Click-to-call
Channel 03 · Organic

Instagram community

Offers become a series, not a poster: a "Deal Drop Friday" reel, a story countdown, early access for close friends, polls that pick next week's bundle. Followers learn there's a reason to check @gtown.l1 every week — which is how 2,655 becomes 15,000.

  • Weekly Deal Drop reel + 24-hour story countdown
  • Broadcast Channel for early access to offers
  • UGC reposts of gift unboxings — the bag, the backpack, the speaker
  • Comment-to-DM automation: comment OFFER, get the store link
KPI · Saves · Shares · Follower growth
Channel 04 · Paid

Meta offer ads

Every offer creative becomes a geo-fenced ad within a few kilometres of each of the 50 stores — served only to legal-age adults nearby, with a Call now or WhatsApp button. Budget follows the offers that are actually converting.

  • 25+ audience, radius set per store
  • Click-to-WhatsApp and click-to-call objectives
  • Catalogue-style carousel of every live offer
  • "Last day" retargeting for engagers who haven't called yet
KPI · Cost per call / WhatsApp · Store redemptions
Every offer ships as one kit: 1 reel3 stories1 WhatsApp card1 Meta ad set1 creator brief — live within 24 hours of the offer hitting the shelf, in one consistent G-Town look.
06 — THE PAID ENGINE

Great content, amplified.

Organic builds the brand; paid puts it on rocket fuel. Here's how we'd spend a rupee so it brings back more than a rupee.

OBJECTIVE · REACH & VIDEO VIEWS

Awareness Ads

Push our best-performing reels to a cold but relevant audience — adults of legal drinking age, within travel range of your outlets in each city. The goal is simple: make G-Town Wines the name people recognise across Gurugram, Faridabad, Rohtak and Sonipat.

We let the algorithm tell us which organic content already resonates, then put budget behind the proven winners instead of guessing.

Retargeting & Lookalikes

The people who watched 75% of a reel, visited the profile, or clicked once are your warmest audience. We re-serve them an offer or a "you forgot something" nudge — and clone them into lookalike audiences to find more people just like your best customers.

Concentrated spend around the moments that actually move liquor: Diwali, New Year's Eve, wedding season, cricket finals, long weekends and Gurugram's house-party circuit. Pre-built creative kits ready to deploy the moment demand peaks.
